title.narrative: Localising Protection: Red Cross Action to Assist the Most Vulnerable in Times of Complex, Humanitarian Crises in Burkina Faso, Uganda, Burundi and Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)

description.narrative: Le programme vise à renforcer la protection humanitaire locale, opportune et inclusive pour les populations vulnérables touchées par la violence et les déplacements au Burkina Faso, en Ouganda, au Burundi et en République démocratique du Congo (RDC). The program aims to strengthen local, timely, and inclusive humanitarian protection for vulnerable populations affected by violence and displacement in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The program aims to strengthen local, timely, and inclusive humanitarian protection for vulnerable populations affected by violence and displacement in Burkina Faso. The program aims to strengthen local, timely, and inclusive humanitarian protection for vulnerable populations affected by violence and displacement in Burundi. The program aims to strengthen local, timely, and inclusive humanitarian protection for vulnerable populations affected by violence and displacement in Uganda.
